schinese.title: 神圣巴蜀帝国 Holy Bashu Empire
schinese.description:
[h1]七圈三十六府，蜀地新百年[/h1]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10089394321281458581/F83AA0978D2C5F5CDC9951FA112EC7774E21A0AB/[/img]

至元末年，蜀地连绵的春雨冲断了北面的栈道。成都府收到的第一封急报，却是汉州的一纸诉状：上游新修的渠堰截住了水，下游的春耕已不能再等。

三十六府的使者于是齐聚锦江。盐商带来账册，关吏呈上欠粮，茶马行首把磨旧的马铃放在案头。各府重订旧盟，推举共主，划分七圈。

帝国的印玺留在成都，钱粮、商路与兵役却仍须逐府议定。盟约落印的第二天，汉州的使者仍站在府衙门前，等着上游放水。

属于蜀地的新百年，就从这一桩尚未办妥的水案开始。

[h2]山川之间，选择一府[/h2]

七个帝国圈，三十六个可选府州诸侯，合计164个地块。
你可以经营锦江两岸的田亩，也可以掌管川南井灶，守住北面的关道，或让茶马商队穿过山门。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16949371261289276822/6273DE1A7E43C1474AD7501E7BF95E8E8BBB40E3/[/img]

[list]
[*][b]巴蜀史实风物。[/b] 都江堰治水、文翁兴学、蜀锦经营、宋代盐井与茶马贸易融入地方背景、事件和课题；山城、蜀道与川江故事各有地理出处。帝国与七圈政制属于架空设定。
[*][b]百年地方经营。[/b] 80项特色科技、405个风味事件、97项非科技决议，围绕各圈产业、民生与军制展开。
[*][b]机构与军伍。[/b] 16种地区建筑、特色产业生产方式、9种特色兵种，把作坊、官学、仓廪和守备纳入本府经营。
[/list]

[h2]名产出蜀，百业相生[/h2]

锦户讲习院里，绣工以彩线成纹；井灶公廨旁，井户取卤煎盐。
关市券所收存契书，纸坊供应驿券与画样；茶马交割场前，商人把茶砖束紧，等候越岭的马队。

蜀绣、井盐、蜀纸与边茶进入各地市场。府第、寺院与市镇有各自的采办，绣坊描样与茶货包装又把蜀纸接进了生产。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17248598049921642797/CC815DB2974E21200EAC7C7C8E53F360C2B0D34C/[/img]

[h2]传习有序，地方各有成法[/h2]

匠师交换器样，官学收录簿册，向导重勘山程。旧日经验写入课题，后来者便能接续前人的经营。

特色科技进入前两个时代的原版科技树，逐级开出地区分支；研究所得连接文化、社会、产业与军制。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17057584865573562887/B5556F29332D0E42690551C0B16429D8AAC60D79/[/img]

[h2]府议与席间[/h2]

府库催着交盐，井户请求停工换绳；船队已经靠岸，掌仓者却仍在核算脚钱。405个事件里的地方人物，各有必须承担的账目。增产、赈济、商运和守备之间，你要替本府作出取舍。

会盟时，共建派谈修渠、道路与仓廪，兴业派谈作坊、商路与文教。为会盟出资，或完成一项地方事业，各府便记下一份贡献。每两年，两派各按贡献分配金币与威望，共同成事还有额外奖赏。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15931706084167562350/EC38A5FB9CBED0FFFFF34CD7AB14671280DF62C4/[/img]

[h2]长路与新乡[/h2]

山中留下黑白足迹，井口露出陌生的巨骨，峡江船夫把暗礁刻进滩记。七圈各有一条约四十五年的地方长线；历次抉择将导向两种不同的长期章程，你也可以中途停止投入。

沿江入蜀的船带来种子、手艺与旧乡的信。十章“湖广填四川”贯穿约四十八年：为来人开簿、分田、授徒，还是守住旧户的名额与礼序，将留下不同的新乡。

独立故事与短链分布在各府。威望、阶层满意度、识字、研究、疾病、粮食、贸易与军备，各有眼前得失；新增事件配有十四幅可共用插图。

[h2]开始游玩[/h2]

[list]
[*]适配EU5 1.4.*，建议单独启用并新开1337年存档。
[*]在巴蜀选择诸侯，从原版科技树、建设与招募界面开始经营；地方事业与府议位于国家内容页。
[*]同圈诸侯开局共同防卫；统治者拥有配偶与随机后代。盟约与家族，都会陪你走入后来的年月。
[/list]

[h2]0.3.1 更新[/h2]

[list]
[*]事件扩展至405个，新增七圈分支长线、共同移民长线及各府独立故事与短链。
[*]抉择加入多种原版资源、期限修正与永久结局，补充配套插图。
[*]修复重复国号、家族姓氏、特色商品修正图标与文本登记；调整产业启动和AI研究、建设优先级。
[/list]

english.title: Holy Bashu Empire
english.description:
[h1]Seven Circles, Thirty-Six Principalities[/h1]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10089394321281458581/F83AA0978D2C5F5CDC9951FA112EC7774E21A0AB/[/img]

Spring rain had broken the plank roads north of Sichuan. The first urgent dispatch to Chengdu came from Hanzhou: a new upstream weir had diverted the water, and the fields below could wait no longer.

Envoys from thirty-six prefectures gathered beside the Jin River. Salt merchants brought their accounts; pass wardens, their grain arrears. The head of a tea caravan laid a worn horse bell on the table. They renewed their compact, elected a common ruler and divided the realm into seven circles.

Chengdu kept the imperial seal. Each prefecture still had to agree its share of grain, military service and the roads. The day after the compact was sealed, Hanzhou's envoy stood outside the magistrate's hall, waiting for the upstream gates to open.

Your next hundred years begin with that unfinished water dispute.

[h2]Choose a Principality[/h2]

Seven imperial circles and thirty-six playable principalities cover 164 locations.
Tend the fields along the Jin River, manage southern salt wells, hold a northern mountain pass, or guide tea caravans through the western valleys.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16949371261289276822/6273DE1A7E43C1474AD7501E7BF95E8E8BBB40E3/[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Regional history and material culture.[/b] Dujiangyan irrigation, Wen Weng's schools, Shu brocade, Song-era salt wells and tea-horse trade inform local backgrounds, events and advances. Mountain fortresses, the Shu roads and river transport draw on Sichuan's geography and historical traditions. The empire and its seven-circle constitution are alternate history.
[*][b]A century of regional development.[/b] 80 unique advances, 405 flavour events and 97 non-technology decisions connect local industries, communities and military institutions.
[*][b]Buildings and troops.[/b] 16 regional buildings, regional production methods and 9 unique unit types bring workshops, schools, granaries and garrisons into your prefecture's economy.
[/list]

[h2]Goods from Sichuan[/h2]

Embroiderers work at the Brocade Academy while salt workers draw brine beside the Well-Salt Office.
Paper workshops supply the Gate Registry with contracts and travel warrants. At the Tea-Horse Exchange, merchants bind their tea bricks for the mountain road.

Shu Embroidery, Well Salt, Shu Paper and Border Tea enter the game's markets. Households, temples and towns place their orders; embroidery patterns and tea packaging give paper a place in other workshops as well.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17248598049921642797/CC815DB2974E21200EAC7C7C8E53F360C2B0D34C/[/img]

[h2]Local Knowledge, Lasting Institutions[/h2]

Artisans exchange patterns, scholars preserve accounts and guides survey the mountain paths. Research lets the next generation carry those practices forward.

Unique advances appear as branching paths in the native technology tree across the first two ages, linking culture, society, production and military organisation.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17057584865573562887/B5556F29332D0E42690551C0B16429D8AAC60D79/[/img]

[h2]In the Council Hall and at the Feast[/h2]

The treasury wants its salt delivered; the workers want to replace a fraying rope. A convoy has reached the riverbank, but the warehouse keeper is still disputing the unloading fee. Local characters have obligations of their own. Your event choices weigh production against labour, relief against reserves, and commerce against defence.

At the imperial feast, the Common Works party favours irrigation, roads and granaries; the Enterprise party favours workshops, trade and learning. Fund the gathering or complete a local project to earn contribution. Every two years, each party distributes gold and prestige by contribution, with further rewards for shared success.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15931706084167562350/EC38A5FB9CBED0FFFFF34CD7AB14671280DF62C4/[/img]

[h2]Long Roads and New Homes[/h2]

Black-and-white tracks appear in the bamboo, strange bones emerge from a salt well, and river pilots record the hidden reefs. Each circle has a local story spanning about forty-five years. Your choices lead to one of two lasting settlements, or you may end the undertaking early.

Boats arriving from Huguang bring seeds, craft skills and letters from home. A ten-chapter migration story spans about forty-eight years: admit new households and apprentices, or protect the claims and customs of established residents.

Independent stories and short chains vary by place. Prestige, estate satisfaction, literacy, research, disease resistance, food, commerce and military supply all enter the choices. Fourteen shared paintings accompany the new events. New event prose is currently in Chinese.

[h2]Starting a Campaign[/h2]

[list]
[*]For EU5 1.4.*. Enable this mod on its own and start a new 1337 campaign.
[*]Choose a Sichuan principality. Use the native research, construction and recruitment screens; local projects and councils appear under country content.
[*]Members of each circle begin with mutual defence. Opening rulers have spouses and a random number of children.
[*]This Workshop page is localised into English. Current in-game text is primarily Simplified Chinese; gallery images retain their Chinese captions.
[/list]

[h2]0.3.1 Update[/h2]

[list]
[*]Expanded to 405 events: branching regional arcs, a shared migration arc, and local independent stories and short chains.
[*]Added native resources, timed effects and lasting endings to choices, with matching event art.
[*]Corrected duplicated polity titles, fictional family surnames, goods modifier icons and text registration; adjusted industry starts and AI research and building priorities.
[/list]
